metadata.question: Does the nighttime light intensity in Aleppo, Syria decrease in 2016 compared to 2012?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use VIIRS/NPP nighttime lights data (VIIRS DNB) - Two time periods: 2012 and 2016 - Location: Aleppo, Syria (approximately 36.2°N, 37.16°E) - Note: VIIRS data starts from April 2012 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for nighttime lights - Filter for high quality observations (cf_cvg = 0) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs Null: - Valid Zero: Legitimate decrease in lights (war-torn area) -> Answer A (Yes, decrease) - If 2016 has higher lights than 2012 -> Answer B (No decrease) - C1: No images found for either year - C2: No valid pixels after processing - C3: Invalid calculation results ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Aleppo, Syria location const aleppo = ee.Geometry.Point([37.16, 36.2]); const region = aleppo.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around city center // Define time periods const start2012 = '2012-04-01'; const end2012 = '2012-12-31'; const start2016 = '2016-01-01'; const end2016 = '2016-12-31'; // Load VIIRS nighttime lights const viirs2012 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(start2012, end2012) .select('avg_rad'); const viirs2016 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(start2016, end2016) .select('avg_rad'); // Check collection sizes const size2012 = await viirs2012.size().getInfo(); const size2016 = await viirs2016.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2012 Images: ${size2012}`); console.log(`2016 Images: ${size2016}`); if (size2012 === 0 || size2016 === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } // Calculate mean composites const mean2012 = viirs2012.mean(); const mean2016 = viirs2016.mean(); // Calculate statistics const stats2012 = await mean2012.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2016 = await mean2016.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const val2012 = stats2012.avg_rad_mean; const count2012 = stats2012.avg_rad_count; const val2016 = stats2016.avg_rad_mean; const count2016 = stats2016.avg_rad_count; console.log(`2012: Mean=${val2012}, Pixels=${count2012}`); console.log(`2016: Mean=${val2016}, Pixels=${count2016}`); // Check for invalid pixels if (count2012 === 0 || count2016 === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } // Check for invalid values if (val2012 === null || val2016 === null || val2012 === undefined || val2016 === undefined || isNaN(val2012) || isNaN(val2016)) { console.log('C3'); return; } // Calculate change const change = val2016 - val2012; const pctChange = ((val2016 - val2012) / val2012) * 100; console.log(`Change: ${change.toFixed(4)} (${pctChange.toFixed(1)}%)`); // Determine answer: decrease means 2016 < 2012 if (val2016 < val2012) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
